statement: Real Chromium rendered the real Office bundle at four viewports and exercised selection, filtering, zoom and pan. Core API responses were deterministic Playwright route fixtures and the page carried a visible MOCK CORE FIXTURE banner. This is renderer and interaction self-test evidence, not live agent activity, not independent acceptance and not Compose acceptance.

method.server: Vite dev server from office/ on 127.0.0.1:4173
method.fixtures: Playwright page.route interception of **/core-api/** with 12 deterministic ParticipantRecord fixtures, 2 Campaigns and 1 Project; a visible MOCK CORE FIXTURE banner was injected before capture
method.scene_harness: office/visual-harness.html, served only by the Vite dev server, excluded from the production build, with a permanent TEST FIXTURE — NOT LIVE CORE DATA banner. It renders the same AgentOfficeIsometric component with deterministic fixtures.

viewports.scene_crop: pannable crop; descendant scene art intentionally exceeds the clipped viewport
pannable crop; descendant scene art intentionally exceeds the clipped viewport

inspector_collapse.action: Hide inspector / Show inspector on the Visual Office tab
inspector_collapse.result: the side panel hides and restores without losing the view or filters

scene_density.result: one unique avatar appearance per participant, non-working poses for STALE/FINAL/UNKNOWN, no document overflow; narrow widths use a pannable crop

empty.result: No recorded participants empty state, zero avatars, no fabricated entity

avatar_bounds.result: Every pair of 84x100 avatar bounds is non-overlapping for 0/1/5/12/30 mixed and 30 Implementers.

duplicate_identity.result: CURRENT wins over STALE/FINAL/UNKNOWN; newest last_observed_at; lexical field tiebreak. Reversed input yields the same station, state and appearance.

artifacts_note: Screenshots are bounded renderer-review artifacts. Page captures carry a visible MOCK CORE FIXTURE banner and scene captures carry a TEST FIXTURE — NOT LIVE CORE DATA header. They must never be read as live agent activity or Core acceptance.

visual_comparison.assessment: dark studio shell/rooms/avatars aligned in direction; simpler flat room geometry, smaller front-facing characters, less volumetric lighting and no animation remain.
